reason: The pre-integration covered lane failed three per-case CPU caps on the approved mission tree, which changes only web/src/flight-column.tsx and web unit tests, so the caps are unrelated drift. The recorded lane ran under concurrent load from parallel worktrees: 368328 ms suite CPU against 265477-284137 ms in four unloaded reproduction runs, and the three small SQLite cases inflated 1.35-2.07x (303/224.7, 103/49.8, 106/61.2). Caps sitting at 1.3-1.5x an unloaded peak cannot survive that contention, so every covered case whose cap sat within 1.54x of its measured lane peak was retuned from the current profile with explicit margin.

Only the covered profile changed: plain caps, integration suite budgets, wall deadlines, assertions and the test-category registry are untouched.
